item.title: Archaeologists digging in Beijing have found the first Great Wall remains from the Sui dynasty
item.description: Recent archaeological discoveries in Beijing have unearthed remnants of the Great Wall from the Sui Dynasty, revolutionizing our understanding of its historical context. This find emphasizes the wall's role as a military outpost on the northern frontier. Additionally, three ancient wooden boats, dating back approximately 1,800 years, were recovered in Fengtai district, showcasing an early transport network in Beijing and shedding light on the area's trade and defense roles. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

Washington no se ha pronunciado al respecto. Entretanto, las fuerzas gubernamentales de Yemen se retiraron de una zona cercana al estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb para, sostienen, centrarse en la defensa de su base principal en Adén.
